known_limitations: All 40 answerable questions target a single technical document ([Eng] Backend Deployment Pipeline Architecture).
No multi-document synthesis or conflicting-source test cases are included.
All questions are in English; multilingual (Ukrainian) queries are not covered in v1.0.0.

Four cases (GS-039, GS-041, GS-044, GS-045) use placeholder tokens ([DB_PROD_CLUSTER], [REDIS_PROD_CLUSTER], [EKS_ENDPOINT], [ALB_ENDPOINT]) in SCRUM-10 spreadsheet while the source PDF contains concrete connection URLs.

labeling_notes: expected_action separates answer-with-citation, safe no-answer, and human escalation.
question_scope distinguishes in-scope, out-of-scope, and restricted requests.
AMBIGUOUS is a supported label, but v1.1.0 contains zero ambiguous cases; this is a coverage gap, not an inferred label.
source_availability describes the evaluated corpus, not every document that may exist elsewhere in the company.
